title.romaji: Chitose-kun wa Ramune Bin no Naka
title.english: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle
title.native: 千歳くんはラムネ瓶のなか

synonyms: Ramune no Bin ni Shizunda Biidama no Tsuki
ラムネの瓶に沈んだビー玉の月
ชีวิตรสโซดาของจิโตะเสะคุง
description:
Being popular isn’t easy. It’s hard to beat Saku Chitose. The most popular kid in his high school? Check. An ironclad reputation that can weather even vicious online attacks? Check. A group of friends as attractive on the outside as they are inside? Check. But when a teacher asks for his help bringing back a student who has been shut away in his room for months, Saku’s perfect world will never be the same. What is this, some kind of normie harem story...?

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: The first episode has an extended runtime of ~34 minutes.

node.description: A girl in [Saku](https://anilist.co/character/208618/Saku-Chitose)'s friend group and a member of the girl's basketball team. With good looks, a carefully crafted image and her flirty personality, Yuzuki is noted to be the one in Team Chitose who thinks the most like Saku. She's a very close friend of [Haru Aomi](https://anilist.co/character/208621/Haru-Aomi)'s.
Ever-popular and a natural flirt, Saku is the star of the show at Fuji High School.

An upperclassman and a friend of [Saku](https://anilist.co/character/208618/Saku-Chitose)'s. Asuka is looked up to by Saku greatly, with the two often meeting at a park near Fuji High. She's mature and often gives Saku advice, but has a mischievous side to herself as well.

A girl in [Saku](https://anilist.co/character/208618/Saku-Chitose)'s friend group and the vice president of their class. Yuuko is somewhat of an airhead who's oblivious to her own charms, but she is highly fashionable and very attached to Saku.

A girl in [Saku](https://anilist.co/character/208618/Saku-Chitose)'s friend group and a member of the girl's basketball team. Haru is very comfortable talking to boys due to her aligning interests with them. She is very athletic, an excellent basketball player and a very close friend of [Yuzuki Nanase](https://anilist.co/character/208619/Yuzuki-Nanase)'s.

A girl in [Saku](https://anilist.co/character/208618/Saku-Chitose)'s friend group. Known to be more of a "self-made" popular girl, she became acquainted with Team Chitose later than the rest. Yua is very kind and polite, but knows when to put her foot down.

A girl attending Fuji High School. Nazuna is a former basketball player that used to look up to [Yuzuki Nanase](https://anilist.co/character/208619/Yuzuki-Nanase) before entering high school. She's friends with [Atomu Uemura](https://anilist.co/character/268036/Atomu-Uemura) and has known him since middle school.

[Saku](https://anilist.co/character/208618/Saku-Chitose)'s casual and carefree homeroom teacher. He makes note of Saku's talents and, using Saku's class president role as an excuse, occasionally has him solve issues for him. Despite his roughness he's very attentive to the issues of his students.

A shut-in boy that hasn't attended school for months on end. Kenta is bitter and depressed, locking himself away in his room, with [Saku](https://anilist.co/character/208618) being chosen by his teacher to bring him back to class by any reasonable means necessary.

~!After reinventing himself with Saku's help, Kenta joins Saku's friend group and becomes good friends with everyone in Team Chitose.!~

A boy in [Saku](https://anilist.co/character/208618/Saku-Chitose)'s friend group. Like Saku, Kazuki is highly athletic and a popular student at Fuji High, being an excellent soccer player. He's laid-back and casual with his friends in Team Chitose, but unlike Saku he maintains a more no-nonsense mindset.

A boy in [Saku](https://anilist.co/character/208618/Saku-Chitose)'s class. Atomu is part of a different clique within Fuji High, and isn't a fan of Saku or his friend group. He's a friend of [Nazuna Ayase](https://anilist.co/character/268034/Nazuna-Ayase)'s and has known her since middle school.

A boy in [Saku](https://anilist.co/character/208618)'s friend group and a member of the boys' basketball team. Kaito is cheerful, energetic, and a good friend of everyone's in Team Chitose, being quick to defend his friends in any situation.
